statement: A resident company pays income tax when profit is distributed, not when it is earned: dividends and other profit distributions are taxed on payment (Income Tax Act § 50(1)), and retained or reinvested profit carries no corporate income tax. The rate is 22%, and for profit distributions the taxable amount is divided by 0.78 before the rate applies, so the charge equals 22/78 of the net distribution (§ 4(1), (1¹)).
caveat: The 22% rate and the 0.78 divisor apply from 2025-01-01 (RT I, 30.06.2023, 107); the former reduced 14/86 rate for regularly distributed dividends was repealed at the same time (§ 4(4) repealed). Participation-exemption rules in § 50(1¹) exempt redistribution of qualifying dividends. The tax is declared on the combined TSD return and paid by the 10th day of the month following the distribution.
